description: SAML brokered login coverage with two distinct identities (similar names) through the same SAML connector; verify identity and protected read behavior for each session.

description: Config change + re-auth coverage: enable SAML connector insecure signature validation, login and verify; then re-enable with CA validation and re-authenticate and verify again.
invariant_hypothesis: Coverage: connector config change followed by re-auth; compare resulting sessions via verify operations.

description: Password grant coverage with two identities plus session revocation: login as two users via password grant, verify, revoke one session, then verify again.
invariant_hypothesis: Coverage: password grant + revoke_session behavior across two identities.

description: SAML brokered login with two identities using different OIDC scopes (openid vs openid+profile+email), then revoke one session and re-verify both sessions.

description: Create a second OIDC client, then perform SAML brokered login for the same upstream identity through two different clients and verify both sessions.

description: SAML connector with allowedGroups gating and filterGroups enabled; authenticate two identities with different group memberships and verify identity + read behavior.

description: Create a second SAML connector with different entityIssuer/ssoIssuer; authenticate the same upstream identity through both connectors and compare resulting sessions via verify operations.
